search.title: Find your bus
search.subtitle: Search the live timetable. Seat availability is checked on the server, not in your browser.
search.sameCity: Departure and destination must be different

results.title: Available buses
results.subtitle: {{origin}} → {{destination}} · {{date}}
results.none: No buses on this route and date
results.noneHint: Try another date or route. Departures appear here as soon as the counter office schedules them.

seat.title: Choose your seats
seat.subtitle: Seats are held on the server for {{minutes}} minutes while you decide.
seat.maxSeats: Up to {{count}} seats in one booking
seat.holdNote: Nothing is charged yet. Continue to enter the passenger details and choose cash or online payment.
seat.expiredHint: Those seats went back on sale. Choose them again if they are still free.
seat.policy: Free cancellation up to {{hours}} hours before departure.
seat.seatTaken: Someone just took one of those seats. The map has been refreshed.
seat.alreadyHeld: This browser already holds these seats.
seat.holdCreated: Seats held — they are yours for {{minutes}} minutes.

passenger.title: Passenger details & payment
passenger.subtitle: Your seats are held for this browser. Tell us who is travelling, then choose how to pay.
passenger.holdExpiredBody: The seats went back on sale. Pick them again if they are still free — it only takes a moment.
passenger.cashBody: The ticket is created now and the seats stay reserved. Pay cash at any counter and staff will confirm it there.
passenger.onlineBody: Card, bKash or Nagad through the SSLCommerz checkout. The ticket is confirmed only after the gateway's own server confirms the money.
passenger.onlineUnavailable: Online payment is not available right now. Choose pay at counter instead.
passenger.maxSeats: Up to {{count}} seats in one booking.
passenger.holdNote: Submitting books these exact seats. If the hold has expired, the server will ask you to choose again.

fields.name: Passenger name
fields.phoneHint: This number opens the ticket later.

errors.name: Enter the passenger name
errors.phone: Enter a valid Bangladeshi mobile number (e.g. 01712345678)

ticket.title: Your ticket
ticket.subtitle: Keep this number. Together with the passenger phone it opens the ticket on any device.
ticket.printHint: Printing hides the buttons and keeps only the ticket on the page.
ticket.forbiddenTitle: This ticket belongs to another passenger
ticket.forbiddenBody: Enter the mobile number used at booking to open it, or use the ticket lookup page.
ticket.verificationHint: The conductor may ask for this code. Do not share the ticket publicly.
ticket.terms: Please arrive 15 minutes before departure. Tickets are non-transferable.
ticket.deadlineBody: Pay before {{time}}, otherwise the seats are released automatically.

notice.paidBody: Show this ticket and the verification code at boarding.
notice.verifyingBody: The gateway has not confirmed the money yet. Refresh in a few seconds; nothing is confirmed until its server answers.
notice.failedBody: No money was confirmed. You can try the payment again while the seats are still held.
notice.cancelledBody: The seats are no longer reserved. Please book a new ticket.
notice.cancelledCheckoutBody: The seats are still reserved for now. You can pay again or pay cash at a counter.
notice.unavailableBody: Your ticket exists and is unpaid. Try paying again, or pay cash at any counter.
notice.expiredBody: The seats were released because the payment did not arrive in time. Please book again.
notice.cashBody: This ticket is not paid yet. Pay {{total}} in cash at any counter; staff will confirm it here.

cancel.title: Cancel this ticket
cancel.subtitle: Cancelling releases the seats for resale and closes this ticket for travel.
cancel.noRefund: The policy gives no refund at this point.
cancel.unpaid: No money has been collected for this booking, so there is nothing to refund.
cancel.already: This ticket has already been cancelled.
cancel.departed: The bus has already departed, so this ticket can no longer be cancelled.
cancel.selfCancelOff: Passengers cannot cancel online right now. Please contact a counter to cancel.
cancel.notPossible: This ticket cannot be cancelled at the moment.
cancel.pendingNote: Refund status: {{status}}. A counter or admin processes it — no automatic gateway refund is issued.

lookup.title: Find a ticket
lookup.subtitle: Enter the ticket number and the mobile number used at booking. Both must match.

counter.title: Counter dashboard
counter.subtitle: Sell seats for cash, find a reservation and collect its payment.
counter.noCounterHint: This login is not linked to a counter yet. Sales are recorded without a counter; an admin can assign you on the Counters page.
counter.searchTripsSubtitle: Search the live timetable, then open the seat map.
counter.searchTripsHint: Enter a route and date to see departures.
counter.selectSeatsHint: Tap the free seats this passenger wants.
counter.selectSeatsFirst: Choose at least one seat before selling.
counter.cashNote: This records a real cash payment. Nothing is charged online.
counter.saleSubtitle: Cash received. Print the ticket and hand it to the passenger.
counter.saleFailed: The sale could not be completed
counter.bookingsSubtitle: Search by ticket number, passenger phone or name.
counter.collectFailed: Could not record the cash payment
counter.rulesBody: Counter sales use the same seat ledger as the website. A seat on hold or already sold cannot be sold twice — the API answers with a clear conflict instead.

driver.title: Driver console
driver.todaySubtitle: Trips assigned to you today, in Dhaka time.
driver.noTrips: No trip is assigned to you today.
driver.chooseTrip: Choose a trip to see its passengers and report your location.
driver.emptyManifest: No passengers on this trip yet.

location.title: Location update
location.subtitle: Type the position reported by the driver or bus assistant. Nothing here is read from GPS automatically.
location.startFirst: Start the trip before reporting a location.
location.invalidCoordinates: Enter a latitude between -90 and 90 and a longitude between -180 and 180.
location.atStop: The bus is standing at this stop
location.manualNote: Manual entry only — no GPS device is connected.

map.title: Trip map
map.subtitle: Route stops and the last manually reported position. No GPS device is connected.
map.autoRefresh: While the trip is running, this map reloads the last report every 30 seconds.
map.manual: Manual report — not a live GPS signal
